item.title: Optimal Transport
item.description: An ongoing study notebook on computational optimal transport. The main idea in these notes is to understand how deterministic transport maps lead naturally to couplings and the Kantorovich relaxation. Theoretical Foundations Monge Problem Motivation: suppose two discrete measures contain the same total mass. A deterministic transport assigns the mass at each source point to exactly one target point. In the uniform case, this reduces to a matching problem. Definition 1
